title: pvAMRContour
body:
## pvAMRContour

AMR Contour (vtkPVAMRDualContour) extracts material interface surfaces from non-overlapping AMR volume-fraction data using the dual grid, so surfaces stay crack-free across refinement levels. For each selected cell array it outputs a block of polygonal surface at VolumeFractionValue (multiplied by 255 internally), optionally capped where the material meets the domain boundary. Use it to visualize material boundaries in CTH-style AMR data; for meshes or image data use contour.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Volume fractions are expected as unsigned char 0-255 (as the Spy Plot reader produces by default); VolumeFractionValue is a fraction of 1 and is multiplied by 255, so 0.5 means a stored value of 127.5.
- Nothing is produced until at least one SelectMaterialArrays entry is given.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMRContour`. Identity: `filters/AMRDualContour`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: non-overlapping AMR data (vtkNonOverlappingAMR). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkNonOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Capping` | If this property is on, the the boundary of the data set is capped. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DegenerateCells` | If this property is on, a transition mesh between levels is created. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MergePoints` | Use more memory to merge points on the boundaries of blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MultiprocessCommunication` | If this property is off, each process executes independently. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectMaterialArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the contour filter will compute contour cells. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SkipGhostCopy` | A simple test to see if ghost values are already set properly. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Triangulate` | Use triangles instead of quads on capping surfaces. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VolumeFractionValue` | This property specifies the values at which to compute the isosurface. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMRContour",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
